closest_parent_domain.justification: AI, in general, is the foundational technology that supports AI applications in genomics, making it the closest parent in terms of technological roots.

closest_child_domain.justification: Focusing directly on machine learning applications in genomics, it represents the next level of detail and specialization within AI in genomics.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Given its specific implications in employing machine learning within biological sciences, this domain is closely aligned with AI in genomics.
